identityEvidence: The public legacy Tunurile Piraților page component references this exact image filename.
The same page component explicitly identifies the attraction as associated with restaurant Paradisul Piraților.
Visual inspection confirms original Tunurile Piraților branding and the foam-ball cannon-game scene described by the historical operator copy.
This is not a current Megazone Bites food photograph or a photograph of the separately named Megazone Kids playground.
displayLimits: Display with a historical/undated caption and an explicit current-operation-unconfirmed notice.
Do not use the image to imply present admission, a currently open playground, or legal continuity with Megazone.
The server modification date is not a verified photograph capture or publication date.
